description: This file declares the MessageClient class responsible for managing message buffers, handling message instances, and factories within the WPEFramework Messaging namespace. It includes methods for adding/removing instances, enabling controls, and processing messages.

classes.name: MessageClient
classes.description: Class responsible for buffer data retrieval, metadata sending, and managing message instances and factories.

methods.name: AddInstance
methods.description: Adds a message instance identified by an ID.

methods.name: RemoveInstance
methods.description: Removes a message instance identified by an ID.

methods.name: WaitForUpdates
methods.description: Waits for message updates for a specified duration.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves control information into a MessageUnit::Iterator.

methods.name: PopMessagesAndCall
methods.description: Processes messages and calls a handler function.

methods.name: AddFactory
methods.description: Adds a factory for a specific message type.

methods.name: RemoveFactory
methods.description: Removes a factory for a specific message type.
